PreToolUse.description: goalforge state-machine guards over plans/**: single-writer (blocks tool-surface mutation of status:/goal_approved_version:), transition-guard (blocks an illegal status edge), open-questions-gate (blocks '-> ready' while an open question is unresolved). Each fast-paths to exit 0 unless the edited file is under a resolved PLANS_ROOT.

PostToolUse.description: goalforge frontmatter-touch: bumps updated:/stage_updated: to today on an edited plans/** .md. Fast-paths to exit 0 unless the edited file is under a resolved PLANS_ROOT.
